name: meeting a word in a lesson adds it to the learner's vocabulary, due immediately and unreviewed
description: Vocabulary used to enter the learner's record only through a graded flashcard, so words met in drills and passages were never tracked. An `encountered` event now adds the word with no SM-2 history: due the day it was seen, because it has been met but never practised, and `reviews` still zero, which is what distinguishes it from a card that lapsed back to repetitions 0. Only the vocab axis is read — the grammar on the same item must not be marked introduced, or any drill would rob the learner of its reference page.
